cells.title: Kreis Press DB
cells.guideText: * Sit on a bench with 45° incline * Hold dumbbells overhead * Move dumbbells down as if doing overhead press * Rotate dumbbells palms facing up and extend your arms in front of your body * Move hands together until dumbbells meet, keep arms extended * Reverse the motion until dumbbells are overhead again * This is one repetition
